name: zclass_util_destroy_node_recursive
description: zClass_Util::DestroyNodeRecursive removes child nodes, releases display instances, deletes class data, and returns the node to the zClass free list.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to the zClass lifecycle source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: The native zClass destroy smoke verifies display-instance release, Object3D class-data cleanup, DI pool free-list insertion, and active-node/free-list counter updates through DestroyNodeRecursive.
